_doc: Two-Project Rule (Brain directive). Maestro works on at most two cartridges concurrently. Slot order is meaningful: slot 1 is the primary focus; slot 2 is the parallel build. Updated by the studio operator (you) — Maestro, Upgrader, and the crash-report API all read this file to decide what they may touch.

slots.notes: Reference cartridge — the GameEngin standard remote and combo system are being authored here first, then standardised across the library.
